items.summary: Update the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) to automatically select the matching shape-specific description template for each product based on its shape field value. When a product's shape is set to 'Turtle', 'Dolphin', 'Frog', or 'Whale', automatically apply the corresponding named template (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, or Whale) to that product's description field. When the shape is set to any other value or is blank, fall back to the 'Default' template. This auto-selection should trigger whenever the shape field changes for a product, and should update the description field with the matched template's content unless the user has manually edited that description field.
